name: zoom-punch
title: Zoom punch
description: Footage that punches in on a point at a moment: a fast keyframed scale toward the focus, then a hold (or an ease back out). The classic emphasis cut for a reaction, a detail or a punchline. Use it as a shot's picture; it fills the frame.

in.description: Source seconds at the shot's start.

at.description: Seconds into the shot when the punch lands.

amount.description: The zoom after the punch (1 = none).

focus.description: The point zoomed toward, [x, y] in design pixels of the frame.

release.description: Seconds after the punch to ease back to 1; null holds the zoom to the end.

flash.description: A quick white flash on the punch.

scale.$expr: (() => { const a = props.at, b = props.at + props.speed; const k = [{t: 0, v: 1}, {t: a, v: 1, ease: 'out-expo'}, {t: b, v: props.amount}]; if (props.release !== null) { k[2].ease = 'in-out-cubic'; k.push({t: b + props.release, v: props.amount, ease: 'in-out-cubic'}); k.push({t: b + props.release + 0.35, v: 1}); } return {keys: k}; })()

opacity.$expr: props.flash ? {keys: [{t: Math.max(0, props.at - 0.02), v: 0}, {t: props.at + 0.02, v: 0.55, ease: 'out-quad'}, {t: props.at + 0.22, v: 0}]} : 0
